rationale: Temporary vendor-feed false positive only for Debian 13 libssl3t64 and openssl-provider-legacy exactly 3.5.7-1~deb13u3, fixed by Debian DSA-6531-1 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-84782). Package/version-scoped Rego applies only to the API image and independently expires. Unpatched packages and other images remain enforced. Remove once the feed recognizes the official patch.
